text:
Alex: proposal: put a small set of "edge-quarantine" lanes in front of regional routers to absorb noisy tenants and experimental workloads. starts with opt-in by customers. :thinking:
Priya: curious — what do you mean by "quarantine" here? isolated queues + lower priority or complete isolation with throttles?
Alex: isolated queues + strict token caps + degraded model tier (cheaper quantized variant) + optional cold storage for KV cache. main goals: protect P99 for committed tenants, and give a soft landing for spikes.
Sam: agree on intent. need clear launch criteria though: what metrics say "quarantine working" vs causing customer-visible errors?
Nate: flag: this will change routing logic and affect affinity. We need rollback plan if affinity breaks for long-tail sessions.
Alex: good call. rough launch checklist suggestion: 1) feature flag behind org-level opt-in, 2) end-to-end canary on staging, 3) SLOs for committed lanes unaffected, 4) alerting on increased error-rate or latency for quarantined lanes, 5) automated rollback if cross-tenant cold-start rate > X.
Priya: and add quality guardrail: prompt-level regressions for downgraded model must be < 2% delta on eval set within 24h. otherwise fallback to higher-tier model.
Sam: operationally we need per-tenant billing signal for when a tenant is moved into quarantine so CS can notify. Also SLA implications: document that quarantined tenants are on best-effort.
Nate: architecture notes: routing decision points: edge proxy -> policy engine -> regional router. quarantine should be implemented as a policy decision at the policy engine layer so we don't duplicate logic.
Alex: agreed. sample policy snippet (proto-ish):
```yaml
route_policy:
  match:
    tenant_tag: noisy
  action:
    lane: edge-quarantine
    model_tier: quantized-v1
    rate_limit: 50rps
    kv_cache_ttl: 0s
```
Priya: nice. also add a TTL for automatic reevaluation (e.g., reevaluate every 6h, and auto-promote if metrics stable for 24h).
Sam: rollout plan idea: start with 10 tenants on staging -> 5 beta customers opt-in on dedicated -> scale to hosted canary for a subset of regions -> global opt-in. Each step gated by: latency P95 for committed tenants unchanged, quarantined lanes stable, CS signoff.
Nate: monitoring: expose per-lane metrics: requests, qps, tail-latency, model-version, kv-miss-rate, cold-starts. dashboard + anomaly alerts.
Alex: customer asks we've already seen: 1) want isolation but keep API parity, 2) want assurance on no token leakage, 3) ability to opt out. We'll capture as acceptance criteria.
Priya: acceptance criteria draft (short): - committed tenants P99 latency within baseline - quarantined tenants have documented degraded QoS - telemetry & billing events emitted - opt-out within 30m via org API - rollback path in 5m via FF toggle.
Sam: can we add a spec for tests? unit: policy engine decision matrix; integ: end-to-end routing with simulated spikes; perf: confirm no >5% tail latency regression on control group.
Nate: ops-runbook stub: how to move tenant manually, how to release cache, how to escalate. keep < 1 page initially.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag "edge-quarantine" created in staging. link: https://deploys.internal/ff/edge-quarantine
Alex: thanks — next steps: Priya to draft acceptance criteria doc, Sam to enumerate metrics and dashboards, Nate to draft runbook. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
Priya: on it.
Sam: will stub dashboards today.
Nate: will draft runbook and ping infra for affinity tests.
Alex: closing for now — feel free to continue async here.
